wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-permission: You do not have permission to change the review status of this revision.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-not-flagge: This revision is not marked with an abuse review tag.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-conflictin: This revision already has a different review verdict. Remove that verdict before you record this one.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-not: This revision is not marked as a false positive.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-disabled: This REST API is not enabled on this wiki.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-unknown-ta: The tag "$1" is not a reviewable tag.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-blocked: You cannot use this API while you are blocked from editing.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-mark-descr: Records a review verdict on a revision. The `false-positive` verdict removes the reviewable tag and adds its false positive version, so the `mw-private-personal-info` tag becomes the `mw-private-personal-info-false-positive` tag. The `no-further-action` verdict adds the no further action version of the tag and keeps the tag that flagged the revision. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-unmark-des: Removes a review verdict from a revision. Removing the `false-positive` verdict restores the reviewable tag in place of its false positive version. Removing the `no-further-action` verdict removes the no further action version of the tag, which puts the revision back in the review queue. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
